mapper.select:
select
from Project_Cp_Subtask pcs left join Project_Cp_Dtl cpd on cpd.Cpd_Id=pcs.Cpd_Id left join Project_Cp cp on cpd.Cp_Id=cp.Cp_Id left join SYS_User u on u.U_ID=pcs.Pcs_Handler where pcs.Pcs_Id=#{pcsId}
mapper.sql: pcs.Pcs_Id as pcsId, pcs.Cpd_Id as cpdId, pcs.Pcs_Task_Name as pcsTaskName, pcs.Pcs_Handler as pcsHandler, u.U_Name as pcsHandlerName, pcs.Pcs_Plan_Start_Time as pcsPlanStartTime, pcs.Pcs_Plan_End_Time as pcsPlanEndTime, pcs.Pcs_Actual_Start_Time as pcsActualStartTime, pcs.Pcs_Actual_Ok_Time as pcsActualOkTime, pcs.Pcs_Task_Content as pcsTaskContent, pcs.Pcs_Ok_Status as pcsOkStatus, pcs.Pcs_Remark as pcsRemark, pcs.Pcs_Prove as pcsProve, pcs.Pcs_Create_Uid as pcsCreateUid, pcs.Pcs_Create_Uname as pcsCreateUname, pcs.Pcs_Create_Time as pcsCreateTime,

cpd.Cp_Id as cpId, cpd.Cpd_Name as cpdName, cpd.Cpd_Code as cpdCode, cpd.Cpd_Parent_Id as cpdParentId, cpd.Cpd_Type as cpdType, cpd.Cpd_Days as cpdDays, cpd.Cpd_Pro_Id as cpdProId, cpd.Cpd_Administration as cpdAdministration, cpd.Cpd_Administration_Url as cpdAdministrationUrl, cpd.Cpd_Remark as cpdRemark, cpd.Cpd_Html as cpdHtml, cpd.Cpd_Plan_Start_Time as cpdPlanStartTime, cpd.Cpd_Plan_End_Time as cpdPlanEndTime, cpd.Cpd_Person_Id as cpdPersonId, cpd.Cpd_Person_Name as cpdPersonName, cpd.Cpd_Start_Time as cpdStartTime, cpd.Cpd_End_Time as cpdEndTime, cpd.Cpd_State as cpdState, cpd.Cpd_Doc as cpdDoc, cpd.Cpd_Create_Uid as cpdCreateUid, cpd.Cpd_Create_Uname as cpdCreateUname, cpd.Cpd_Create_Time as cpdCreateTime
